about: Tooltip — a few words about a control, shown on hover and on focus. Use for: the name of an icon-only button, or a short supplement to a control that already says what it does. Don't use for: anything

content.about: The words. Short: a name or a phrase. Anything longer, or anything a reader needs, is not a tooltip.

children.about: The one focusable element it belongs to (a button, a link).

labels.about: The words are the element's name (an icon-only button with no visible text of its own), not a description added after its name.

placement.about: Above the element (default) or below it.

open.about: Shown whatever the pointer and focus do: for documentation and design review, not for use on a page.
